title: Integer coefficient modulo two
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional cube over the field with two elements to that field, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The integer sum over $T\subseteq S$ of $(-1)^{|S|-|T|}$ times the indicator that $f$ is $1$ on the vector with ones exactly in $T$, reduced modulo two, equals the coefficient of the monomial indexed by $S$ in the algebraic normal form of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the cube over the field with two elements
